All values mm, full-size master patterns (no scaling) (chord widths / centerline heights). Mouth O3.988 m, aperture O5.000 m. Cut fabric from the 1:1 templates in this pack.
Orientation: lay every panel with its ROW HEIGHT across the 1,524 mm / 60 in bolt and its GORE WIDTH along the 3,658 mm / 12 ft table. 'Spare' is what is left over in each direction - all 17 panels fit with room, which is how the master patterns were drawn. The eye pods are the only pieces in the pack too big for any bolt; they are pieced from strips - see alien-balloon-eyes.pdf.
